SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. Rr.........
File No............9..3..19

(C.I.D.) Office Notes

Central Station,
March 8, 1929.

RE ALLEGED OUTRAGE ON JAPANESE GIRL BY A PREACHER

Sir,
    With reference to an article appearing in the
Shanghai Nippo, dated March 7, referring to an alleged
outrage perpetrated by a Japanese named Adachi, posing
as a "Tenrikyo" preacher, upon a young Japanese girl who
is said to have subsequently died, I called upon a
responsible officer of the Japanese Consular Police who
in connection with this matter made the following statement:-
"This incident was reported to the Japanese Police by Mrs.
Kobayashi, residing in the Chang An Li(長安里) off
Woosung Road who is the sister of the girl, almost a
month after the death. Subsequent inquiries revealed
that some time in the middle of October a Japanese male
named K. Adachi(35), who was in the habit of frequenting
the "Tenrikyo" mission at 285 Miller Road posing as a
preacher, came to know one of the adherents named K.
Kawahara, a girl of 23 years of age who was apparently
suffering from consumption. Kawahara was evidently
seeking divine power to cure her illness and Adachi,
taking advantage of this, induced her to live with him at
his house in Jubong Road, near the market on Woosung Road
Extension, Chapei, under the pretext of giving her
constant attendance and to work a spiritual cure. They
have been cohabiting for several months and in the mean-
time the woman's illness became serious and she died on
January 12, 1929. Adachi, who soon became tired of her,
deserted her in the beginning of January, some time before
her death. He is believed to have gone to Hongkong."
    The Japanese authorities are investigating the
whereabouts of Adachi, but they are uncertain as to
whether or not his act constitutes a crime as Kawahara
had willingly cohabited with Adachi for several months,
and furthermore, Mrs. Kobayashi, the sister of the
deceased woman, did not report the matter to the Police
until a month after the death of the woman, who is
alleged to have complained about Adachi's alleged act of
violence just before her death.
                I remain, Sir,
                    Yours obediently,

                    S. Muragawa.

                    J. D. I.

Wmact
S/S Superintendent,
(A Division).
R.C.
a. e (e.)
Superintendent

（刑事调查处）办公笔记

中央巡捕房，
1929年3月8日。

关于一名传教士涉嫌对日本少女施暴一事

先生：
    鉴于3月7日《上海日报》（Shanghai Nippo）刊登的一篇文章，提及一名自称“天理教”传教士的日本人名叫 Adachi，涉嫌对一名据称随后死亡的日本年轻少女实施暴行，我拜访了日本领事警察的一名负责官员，他就此事作了如下陈述：
    “此案由死者之姐、居住于吴淞路长安里（長安里）的 Kobayashi 夫人，在死者去世近一个月后向日本警方报告。随后的调查显示，去年十月中旬左右，一名名叫 K. Adachi（35岁）的日本男子，惯常出入位于米勒路285号的‘天理教’传道所，伪装成传教士，结识了一名信徒 K. Kawahara，这是一名23岁的少女，显然患有肺结核。Kawahara 显然在寻求神力以治愈疾病，Adachi 利用这一点，以提供持续照料并施行灵性疗法为借口，诱使她与其同居于闸北吴淞路延伸段市场附近的 Jubong 路（音译）他的住所内。两人已同居数月，在此期间，该女子病情加重，并于1929年1月12日死亡。Adachi 很快便对她感到厌倦，在她死前不久的1月初抛弃了她。据信他已前往香港。”
    日本当局正在调查 Adachi 的下落，但他们不确定其行为是否构成犯罪，因为 Kawahara 是自愿与 Adachi 同居数月的；此外，死者之姐 Kobayashi 夫人直到死者去世一个月后才向警方报告此事，而据称死者仅在临终前抱怨过 Adachi 涉嫌实施的暴力行为。
                此致，
                    您忠实的仆人，

                    S. Muragawa.

                    J. D. I.

Wmact
S/S 警司，
（A 分区）。
R.C.
a. e (e.)

Extract from Morning Translation dated March 3, 1939

"TENRIKYO" PREACHER SOUGHT BY JAPANESE AUTHORITIES
FOR OUTRAGE ON YOUNG GIRL.

The Shanghai Nippo publishes the following reports:-

A Japanese named Adachi (35), who used to frequent
the "Tenrikyo" Mission (a Japanese religion) in Zeu Tseng
Nan Li (尊德里) of Miller Road posing as one of the
preachers, is now being sought by the Japanese Consular
Authorities for having violated a young Japanese girl, aged
23, the sister of the wife of one Obayashi, under the
pretext of curing the girl's illness by a certain
religious ceremony. The incident occurred some time in
the middle of last month. The girl, who died several
days after the alleged treatment, told her sister,
just before her death, that she had been ravished
several times by Adachi and that she was too weak to
bear the strain. The poor girl had apparently been
terrified into silence by this brutal preacher under
some religious excuse. Adachi is said to have fled to
Hongkong.

Det. Inspector Nakagawa,
For inquiry and
report please.
W.S.
3/3/39.

Supt.

Senior Detective A.
P. C. 4/3.

摘自1939年3月3日的晨间译文摘录

日本当局因一名年轻少女受辱案通缉“天理教”传教士。

《上海日报》发布如下报道：

一名名叫 Adachi（35岁）的日本人，曾经常出入位于米勒路尊德里（Zeu Tseng Nan Li）的“天理教”传道所（一种日本宗教），伪装成传教士之一，现正被日本领事当局通缉，因其借口通过某种宗教仪式治愈疾病，强奸了一名23岁的日本年轻少女，该少女是 Obayashi 妻子的妹妹。事件发生在上个月中旬左右。这名女孩在据称接受治疗后几天死亡，她在临终前告诉姐姐，她曾多次被 Adachi 奸污，且身体过于虚弱，无法承受这种折磨。这名可怜的女孩显然在这位残忍的传教士以某种宗教借口为掩护下，因恐惧而保持沉默。据说 Adachi 已逃往香港。

中川 侦探督察，
请查询并报告。
W.S.
1939年3月3日。

警司。

高级侦探 A.
P. C. 3月4日。
